overview: AI Notes Analyzer is an intelligent study assistant that transforms raw student notes into structured study material. It automatically generates summaries at three detail levels, extracts key concepts, and organizes everything in a clean dashboard — helping students study faster and more effectively.
features: Paste or type notes for instant AI analysis
Three-level AI summarization: short, medium, and detailed
Dashboard with all saved notes, search, and sorting
Note detail view with original text, summaries, and keyword tags
Study stats: total notes and words analyzed
